title: TechBridge Landing Page
description: Build a responsive landing page for the TechBridge internship platform.
details: Create a responsive TechBridge landing page using HTML5 and CSS3. Focus on clear structure, responsive layouts and a consistent visual style.

title: TechBridge Programs
description: Create a programs page that presents the available TechBridge programs.
details: Create a programs page that presents the available TechBridge programs and their key information.

title: Internship Tasks Experience
description: Present the 30-day internship journey and the eight internship tasks.
details: Present the 30-day internship experience and the eight tasks in a clear and easy-to-follow journey.

title: Interactive Internship Task Tracker
description: Build an interactive roadmap for the Data Analytics and Web Development tracks.
details: Build an interactive internship roadmap that allows users to switch between the Data Analytics and Web Development tracks.

title: Challenge Hub
description: Build a challenge section where interns can explore and filter development challenges.
details: Build the TechBridge Challenge Hub where interns can explore and filter challenges by development track.

title: Intern Dashboard
description: Build an interactive dashboard for tracking internship progress and exploring technologies.
details: Build an interactive intern dashboard for tracking tasks, monitoring progress and exploring modern web technologies.

title: Task Management API
description: Build a backend API and connect it to the TechBridge intern dashboard.
details: Build a Node.js and Express.js REST API that provides internship tasks, supports viewing individual tasks and allows task status updates from the dashboard.

title: TechBridge Final Web Project & Deployment
description: Integrate the TechBridge dashboard, Challenge Hub, task management API and responsive web experience into a complete internship platform.
details: Build and deploy the final TechBridge Intern Management Platform by integrating the Challenge Hub, Intern Dashboard, Task Management API, interactive features, responsive design, loading and error states, search, and professional UI.
